column2: Claude, checkout's extinct. A hundred and twenty-eight commits. I'm checking them one by one.
Here we observe the junior developer, in her natural habitat.
She is on commit four. At this pace, she will finish on Thursday.
Run git bisect start. Mark an earlier commit good, the broken one bad. Git picks between them.
Test checkout. Tell Git good or bad. Repeat. Each test roughly halves the suspects.
Bad. Good. Good. Bad. Good. Bad. Bad.
A hundred and twenty-eight suspects. Seven checks. Remarkable.
Found it! "Small harmless cleanup." Who wrote... oh. It's me.
